svg.title: Bé Khế emotional states and a sample lesson reaction
svg.desc: A reference sheet showing eight emotional expression states of the Bé Khế starfruit mascot, and a sample correct and wrong answer reaction combining a line, sound, haptic and motion.
svg.text: one little star, eight feelings. swap the face + a bit of motion and the app feels alive.
A reaction = line + face + sound + haptic + motion
fired together on the beats that matter. here are the two that count most.

g.text: face Cheer — one arm up, sparkle
is sneaky. Here's the real one:”
face Oops — reaches a hand toward you
motion soft head-tilt ±4° · NO harsh shake
tone Qs replay the audio, don't just buzz

svg.text: Rule: the UI marks "incorrect" crisply, but Bé Khế's body language always reads as on-your-side — concerned FOR you, never angry AT you.
